response.sql: WITH overall_stats AS (SELECT AVG(HGB) as overall_avg FROM Laboratory WHERE HGB IS NOT NULL), patient_avgs AS (SELECT ID, AVG(HGB) as patient_avg FROM Laboratory WHERE HGB IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ID), above_average AS (SELECT pa.ID, pa.patient_avg FROM patient_avgs pa CROSS JOIN overall_stats os WHERE pa.patient_avg > os.overall_avg), above_avg_stats AS (SELECT AVG(patient_avg) as mean_of_above_avg FROM above_average) SELECT aa.ID, aa.patient_avg, aa.patient_avg - os.overall_avg, aa.patient_avg - aas.mean_of_above_avg FROM above_average aa CROSS JOIN overall_stats os CROSS JOIN above_avg_stats aas ORDER BY (aa.patient_avg - aas.mean_of_above_avg) DESC LIMIT 10
